crossRefs.note: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
“Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you, and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.
“Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
Behold, your house is left to you desolate.
For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’ ”
This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…
One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains…
Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go…
I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”
Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since…
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…
whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but…

translations.web: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper.’ ”
translations.bsb: For I tell you, not one of those men who were invited will taste my banquet.’”
translations.kjv: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.
translations.asv: For I say unto you, that none of those men that were bidden shall taste of my supper.
